lspVersion.comment: Bundled language server numeric release version.

platform.comment: linux, win32, darwin, web or other only.

ai.user.id.comment: Usage only: random local installation UUID, erased on usage opt-out. Not a person or machine ID.

ai.session.id.comment: Usage only: random per-activation UUID. Never included in error events.

sequence.comment: Usage only: increasing sequence within an activation, not a complete interaction history.

ai.location.ip.comment: Constant 0.0.0.0 masking override, never a client IP.

durationMs.comment: Completed synchronous activation setup, not LSP readiness or installation count.

panel.comment: visualizer, workbench, dashboard, inspector or sysrunner; creation or reveal only.

view.comment: Built-in elk, ibd, activity, state, sequence, usecase, tree, package, graph or hierarchy.

durationMs.comment: Optional elapsed milliseconds, including export dialog wait; not diagram render timing.

action.comment: preview, apply or export. Bulk imports are included in preview/apply.

outcome.comment: success, failure, rejected or cancelled. Invalid/stale edits are rejected, not unexpected bugs.

durationMs.comment: Elapsed host operation milliseconds, including export dialog wait.

action.comment: start, restart or model. Model includes background uncached requests, not just direct user actions.

durationMs.comment: Elapsed milliseconds; model includes warm-up retries and conversion, cache hits omitted.

component.comment: visualizer, workbench, explorer or language. No identity or sequence on this event.

operation.comment: Reviewed built-in operation belonging to the component.

code.comment: start-failed, request-failed, render-failed, export-failed or edit-failed only; never exception text.
